thread:
ana: Heads-up: after the keystore policy change that added strict tag-based bindings for kms:Decrypt in ap-south, we started seeing mTLS handshakes failing on the service mesh egress (worker -> billing-svc) around 02:04 IST. Errors are 'remote error: tls: handshake failure' and proxy logs show unwrap errors.

chris: grabbing mesh logs. Any KMS Deny traces?

ana: typo: ana here. yes, KMS audit shows Deny with ConditionMismatch for aws:RequestTag/keystore-owner. Sample:
```
2024-04-17T02:04:12Z billing-proxy ap-south-1: kms Decrypt Deny: Condition check failed: expected tag keystore-owner=service-billing
```

kev: that indicates the ephemeral cert unwrapping path expects the request to carry keystore-owner tag. Looks like our outbound sidecar isn't forwarding the tag for pod-identity projection after the recent pod-identity-controller upgrade.

chris: confirm: the RBAC change used tags instead of role ARNs to narrow scope. Pod-identity controller v2.3 changed annotation -> projection key name. rollout might have left older sidecars without the new key.

sec-oncall: immediate options? rollback tag change or patch sidecars?

ana: two short-term fixes: 1) add a temporary role-based allow for billing-proxy-ap to keystore (fast but broad) 2) patch pod-identity on ap-south nodes to restore previous annotation mapping (safer). Prefer #2 if we can patch quickly.

chris: patching pod-identity controller across ap-south nodepool now. I have a canary patch to the DaemonSet that restores old projection key mapping for legacy sidecars.

ci-bot: @chris CI pipeline for mesh-components passed for patch 9823, helm lint OK.

kev: also add an immediate metric filter: KMS.Decrypt Deny where ConditionMismatch AND resource contains "billing/proxy" -> alert to sec-oncall.

ana: good call. Also need a short TTL exception if patch fails. deploy-bot: can we author a timebound IAM exception for role arn:aws:iam::111111:role/billing-proxy-ap with kms:Decrypt until 2024-04-17T03:00:00Z?

ops-bot: IAM exception ticket created: IAM-EX-2024-178. Please include justification and expiry.

chris: patch applied to canary (5 nodes). Observability: handshake failures dropped to 0 on canary. Rolling to remaining nodes now.

kev: after rollout, run the cert-unwrap test script across 20 pods:
```
for p in $(kubectl -n billing get pods -l app=billing -o name | head -n 20); do kubectl exec -n billing $p -- /bin/check-cert-unwrap.sh || echo fail:$p; done
```

ana: running that now. 20/20 successful on canary, 12/20 failed pre-patch on remaining nodes.

chris: full rollout complete. Monitoring for 30m.

sec-oncall: marking incident sev P2. Please prepare follow-up CRs: 1) add RBAC rollout gating that runs cert-unwrap tests in each region before promoting tag-based keystore bindings 2) revert to tag-binding only after mesh components have compatible projection versions 3) add analytics for KMS.ConditionMismatch counts per region.

ana: agreed. I'll file the CRs and own follow-up. Note for postmortem: include pod-identity change log, iam policy diff, KMS audit samples, and timeline for canary.

ci-bot: created PRs: RBAC-rollout-gate (https://git.internal/rbac/pull/1102) and mesh-compat-check (https://git.internal/infra/pull/774).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-189 linked to PRs. Closing after 1h steady. :white_check_mark:
